recipe_version.title: Grilled Mackerel with Fennel and Orange
recipe_version.description: Whole mackerel grilled with fennel wedges and an orange-parsley relish. Olive oil, no butter.

ingredients.name: orange
ingredients.note: one juiced, one cut into thin rounds

steps.title: Heat the grill and make the relish
steps.body: Light the grill so it is hot by the end of prep. Toss the fennel with 1 tbsp olive oil and 1/2 tsp salt. Stir the orange juice, chopped parsley, garlic, red pepper flakes, remaining olive oil, and 1/4 tsp salt into a relish. Season the mackerel inside and out with the last 3/4 tsp salt and the pepper, and tuck a few orange rounds and fennel fronds into the cavities. About 15 minutes.

steps.title: Grill
steps.body: Grill the fennel over a cooler spot, turning once, until tender and marked, about 8 minutes. Grill the mackerel over direct heat, about 4 minutes per side, until the flesh is opaque at the bone and 145 F. Cook is 18 minutes with the fennel starting first.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Spoon the relish over the fish and fennel. Serve with lemon wedges.
